title: MCP diagnostics log a refused verb with the control-surface code (storage_error) instead of the code the client received (work_invalid)
outcome: MCP diagnostics log a refused verb with the control-surface code (storage_error) instead of the code the client received (work_invalid)
acceptance: An MCP verb refusal is recorded in the diagnostics ring with the same error code the MCP client received (for example work_invalid for a live-handoff-offer refusal), not the control surface's store_error_code mapping
Control-surface diagnostics keep their existing codes
A test covers an MCP work_invalid refusal and asserts the recorded diagnostics code
